Actual Required PayRun staging seeds the same event/run/source/period/job with a differing connector; the new test neither fabricates a stage result nor writes a draft directly. Only one real workflow_drain::spawn occurs in this fresh-process test. Its stop log is emitted after run_tick returns, so the test waits for the whole pass before closing App pools; late successful ACK/audit in that pass remains observable. Existing direct app dependencies provide PgPayRunPort, PayrollDraftStaging, StagePayrollDraft and tracing collector APIs. The public stage call infers the error type and is source-compatible with both the old KernelError and current typed result. No future-interface method is invented by the candidate.
